National Institute of Design vs Unitedworld Institute of Design is a national design institute compared with a private design school. NID lists NID DAT. Unitedworld has the only usable post-2020 placement average on this page.

sections.heading: National Institute of Design vs Unitedworld Institute of Design for Master of Design: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose NID Ahmedabad if you want a national design institute and can take NID DAT. This page has no NID fee row, and its latest recorded placement year is 2017, with no usable average or highest figure.

Choose Unitedworld Institute of Design if you want a recorded year tuition of ₹1.38 lakh and a 2022 average package of ₹14 lakh. The highest package in that row is recorded as zero, so we do not quote a highest figure for Unitedworld.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: NID has no Master of Design fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Check NID's official admissions fee notice for the postgraduate programme before you budget.
Unitedworld Institute of Design has recorded tuition of ₹1.38 lakh a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed two-year total, until you check the official circular.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Unitedworld's recorded 2022 average package is ₹14 lakh. The highest package in that row is recorded as zero, so we do not treat it as a usable highest figure. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

NID's latest recorded placement year here is 2017, with both average and highest recorded as zero. Because the year is older than 2020 and the figures are unusable, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result. Ask NID for its latest official placement report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: NID lists NID DAT on this page. Admission to NID's Master of Design follows the official DAT process published each year.
Unitedworld has no exam listed in our records here. Confirm its official postgraduate admissions page for tests, portfolios and eligibility.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different sites. NID is a national institute campus. Unitedworld Institute of Design is a private design school.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, the entrance test and the official fee will decide more than the city name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you can take NID DAT and want a national institute, NID is the stronger official name, but this page has no fee and no usable recent placement row for it.
If you want a recorded year fee and a 2022 average package on this page, Unitedworld is the side we can quote, at ₹1.38 lakh tuition and a ₹14 lakh average.
Do not invent a NID fee or treat zero recorded packages as salaries.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, NID Ahmedabad or Unitedworld Institute of Design, for M.Des?
faqs.answer: NID is the national institute and lists NID DAT, but this page has no fee and no usable recent placement row for it. Unitedworld has recorded tuition of ₹1.38 lakh a year and a 2022 average package of ₹14 lakh, with no usable highest figure.

faqs.question: What are the recorded M.Des fees?
faqs.answer: NID has no fee record on this page. Unitedworld has recorded tuition of ₹1.38 lakh a year. Check NID's official admissions fee notice and Unitedworld's official circular.

faqs.question: Does NID accept NID DAT for the master's programme?
faqs.answer: Yes. NID lists NID DAT on this page. Confirm the current official DAT process. Unitedworld has no exam listed here.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Unitedworld's recorded 2022 average is ₹14 lakh; the highest in that row is not usable. NID's latest recorded year here is 2017, with unusable zero figures, and is not treated as a current result.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses.
